Oyunun ilk başlarında, oyunculara birkaç otobüs verilir ve bu otobüsleri kullanarak para kazanmaları gerekiyor. Otobüslerin park yerlerinden alınması, yolcu alma ve bırakma noktalarına götürülmesi ve rotaların planlanması oyunda en temel işlemler arasında yer alıyor.  Oyun ilerledikçe, oyuncular farklı otobüs modelleri satın alabilirler ve bu otobüslerin özelliklerini ve görünümlerini özelleştirebilirler. Ayrıca, otobüslerin bakımı ve onarımı da oyuncuların sorumluluğundadır.  City Bus Manager oynarken, zorluk seviyesi giderek artar. Oyuncuların daha fazla otobüs satın almaları, yeni rotalar açmaları ve işletmelerini büyütmeleri gerekiyor. Ancak, bu zorluklar oyuna daha fazla heyecan katıyor ve oyuncuların oyun dünyasına daha fazla bağlanmalarını sağlıyor.  Oyunun grafikleri oldukça iyi tasarlanmış ve oyunculara gerçekçi bir otobüs işletmeciliği deneyimi sunuyor. Ayrıca, oyunun müzikleri de oldukça keyifli ve dinlendirici.  Sonuç olarak, City Bus Manager oyunu otobüs işletmeciliği konusunda uzmanlaşmak isteyen oyuncular için oldukça keyifli bir seçenek sunuyor. Oyun, detaylı bir yönetim gerektiriyor ancak bu da oyunun zorluğunu artırarak oyunculara daha tatmin edici bir deneyim sunuyor.

I really don't understand the love for this game.  I tried.  The art style is beautiful, the characters quirky and macabre, the setting is great.  It's so frustrating and so boring.  Constantly killed by random things that there's no way to defend against, not enough supplies to stay alive or progress...I don't get it.  I love Ark, Atlas, Raft, etc and while those can be very difficult at times, it's not boring or repetitive the way this is.  Each biome is fairly identical to the last aside from new random things that want to kill you and the absence of very necessary items that you have to go elsewhere to find (but likely won't have time to before it gets dark and oh you don't have enough grass to make a torch so you're dead again.  Walk back to spawn point.  Walk back to body.  Repeat).  I didn't play long, I'll admit that right off, but I've never played a game that I've tried so hard to like and failed so spectacularly.  I've never played a game with overwhelmingly positive reviews like this one that I've found absolutely no joy in.  I like games with challenge, so it's actually satisfying when you achieve something, but each 'achievement' I made in this game (and by achievement I mean picked up enough pieces of wood to craft something -no puzzles, no strategy) felt hollow with the knowledge that I'd be starting from square one again very soon.    I'm clearly the odd person out, because there are so many reviews proving others get enjoyment from this, but I wanted to share my dissenting opinion in case it spared someone else the same cost and hours of frustration.  If you get it, hope you have more fun than I did.

艺术风格满分；原声音轨满分。游戏体验感觉良好，可能因为制作组经验不足，剧情过场非常生硬，但是因为故事本身质量过硬所以弥补了剧情上的缺点。战斗操作非常流畅，射击手感优秀，敌人种类丰富，应对策略也不同。最令人惊喜的是游戏优化，首发就可以让中低配电脑稳定60帧而且没有恶性bug的3A大作近几年可不多见了。  大部分玩家批评的两个缺点：解谜过多和资源管理，可能是对这类游戏有所误解。可以跟同类型游戏，掠食和Bioshock做对比。BioShock系列的解谜也不少（尤其是前两作的水管工小游戏），子弹和药物更是缺上加缺，技能也是需要法力值的。在掠食里你需要去好几个电脑里找开门密码，找通风管或者狗洞钻，或者干脆去外面绕一大圈。资源管理也十分头疼，硬刚几个大风暴异魔，各种子弹，药物和蓝条就见底了。而原子之心里技能没有法力值消耗，武器也有不需要子弹的枪，也有无限刷机器人的办法，在资源管理上要轻松一大截。  9/10

Oyuna giriyorum bildirim, donuyor kapatıyorum bildirim, tekrar giriyorum bildirim. Bitti mi çilesi, HAYIIIIIRR. Günde 25'ten fazla rahatlıkla bildirim almıştır. Artı olarak oyun donunca ekranı kilitliyor ve PC resetlemeden düzelmiyor. Ama o kadar çok karşılaştım ki, yeni taktik geliştirdim. Eğer ki oynayacak kadar 'mazo'ysan ahanda :  - Oyunu açmadan önce arkaya bir program aç(pc yormayan bir şey olursa kafan rahat olur.). - Oyun donduğunda alt+tab ile alttaki sekmeye geç. - Ctrl+shift+esc ile görev yöneticisini aç. - Sonrasında 'F' tuşuna basarak F3'ü bul. Ekranda görüntü olmayacağı için alt+tab yaparak bakman lazım hangi uygulamada olduğuna. - Bulunca da klavyende backspace (silme tuşu işte) üstünden (veyahut ona yakın) ''Delete(DEL olabiliyor)'' tuşuna bas. Hadi geçmiş olsun.  DİPNOT : SSD sağolsun, hiçbir bekleme ekranı tavsiyesi okumadım.

Gameplay is not bad. Gunplay feels good and responsive and there is a good variety of abilities spread across the roster. It's more damage focused with no dedicated healers but the booster and revival mechanic adds a lot to the combat once you get the hang of it. Other than timegating the missions for some reason, you get in game currency for unlocking new mobile suits damn well faster than the glacial progression of Apex or R6 for example. The starting roster is fine but yes, the current unlockable units are a bit stronger.The reason why I can't recommend this is that unlike Overwatch, once a player leaves your team there is no chance a random player will replace that empty slot. And I'm talking about casual matchmaking, not ranked. To add insult to injury, the game will state that there is no penalty for leaving once another player has abandoned the game but you cannot find a new match until the current one has ended so what's even the point? If you're desperate for a Gundam game, which given the state of Gundam games in general is more than likely, it's not a bad game to pick up. If they just make changes to the matchmaking I'd give this a recommend but as it stands, I cannot.   Seriously would it kill them implement something to fill in leavers in matches.

I've been waiting for a good Zoo building game since I was a kid and played old School Zoo Tycoon and I have to say (no offense to the Tycoon games) this one is by far the best I've played. The customization is amazing!  Pros:  -Building I love the ability to customize every building and give the zoo very unique themes. I love creative games like these and the options for decor are amazing. The best part is that if you don't see a theme that you like, just create one! There are plenty of base objects to choose from.   Now, If you suck at building like me, there are plenty of options for pre-built enclosures and staff buildings.   -Super cute animals Sometimes I get zoned out just watching the animals, they have so many interactions with each other and their environments that you get lost and feel like you're watching an actual documentary. The choices of animals are extensive as well. There will be no problem finding the right critters for your zoo. Even the small enclosure animals (snakes, iguanas, Turtles, etc.) are rendered beautifully.   -Challenging Game Play The scenarios and general challenges of the game create a good contrast to the absolute astonishing customization. If you are more into game challenges than building; this is still a really great game. Each of the scenarios offers a unique scenario that focuses on different obstacles and aspects of the game. Building, conservation, animal welfare, Income, etc. You can find unique challenges for almost every aspect.   Even better than just being challenged, you actually LEARN valuable things about Conservation in the real world, animal welfare and even tips for running a spectacular zoo.  - Conservation, Conservation, Conservation!! Learn about your animals! Learn about real methods to help them!  As an animal lover This is one of my favorit aspects. Many people see zoos as any other entertainment method or money pit, but that's not all a zoo does and this makes my hear so warm.   -Franchise The ability to have franchises is awesome. It means, that you can start a really terrible Zoo that brings in money and nothing else, then later create a better Zoo with features you have unlocked and possibly even conservation points to use on other aspects.   Cons:  -Pathing and Indoor Enclosures Really, my ONLY issue with the game is pathing. Particularly with trying to build indoor options for guests and reptile houses. You have to do quite a bit of fanangling to get the paths to work with indoor options sometimes and it can be very frustrating. So far as I can tell, there are no pre-built options for indoor attractions, so it is all up to you. In addition, there is no option to see through a roof to get a better angle on your exhibits without zooming in completely. Underground viewing areas are not impossible, but are very hard to create without a good knowledge of how the pathing system works and there is no in-game tutorial for it. I've had to rely on Youtubers who are amazing builders  for knowledge and sometimes it can be hard to find good instruction.  -Picnic Tables? Phasmophobia arkadaşlarınızla oynayabileceğiniz en sağlam korku oyunlarından bir tanesi. Öyle sağlam bir oyunu ki korku türünde olan bu yapımın yeri geliyor sizi kahkaha tufanına sokabilecek anlar yaratmaktan asla çekinmez.  Oyunun amacı belirli bir mekanda ekipmanlarla giriş yaptığımız ve hangi hayalet türünün gezdiğini dikkatlice inceleyip sonuç çıkarmaya çalıştığımız bir yapımdır. Her hayaletin kendine has tavırları, avantajları ve dezavantajları vardır. A ve B üzerinden örnek verirsem A hayaleti karanlık ortamlarda güçlü iken B hayaleti ışık açık olmasına rağmen atağa kalkabiliyor.  Mekanlarda kanıt toplamamız gereken paranormal olayları ekipman kullanarak birbirinden ayırmanız gerekiyor. Hayaleti görünüşüyle ayırt edebilir miyim derseniz maalesef hayır. Bütün hayaletler her bir mekana girdiğinizde karşınıza random modellerle karşınıza çıkıyor ve görünümleri size hiç hoş gözükmeyecek. Özellikle bir eve giriş yaptığınızda akıl sağlığınıza özen göstermeyi de ihmal etmeyin. Olası etkinliklerde, hayalet ataklarında ve karanlık altındayken akıl sağlığınız ciddi derece düşebiliyor. Eğer akıl sağlığınız yüzde 20 ve altıysa hayalet atağı yeme olasılığınız daha yüksek oluyor.   Phasmophobia başta eğer bu tarz bir oyun oynamadıysanız size çok karışık gelebilir ama 2-3 saat oynayış ve arkadaşlarınızın tavsiyeleri ile kafanızda oturtacağınıza emin olabilirsiniz. Oyunu daha ileri şekilde öğrenmek istiyorsanız belirli phasmophobia mainlemiş youtuber ve yayıncılardan izlemeniz sizin için en doğru karar olabilir.  [i] 'Şimdi böylesine bir korku oyununda nasıl kahkaha atmamızı bekliyorsun?' [/i] diye sorarsanız çok basit. Öyle komik ölümler yaşayıp çığlık atacağınız olaylar olacak ki yaşayacağınız duygular adeta çorba haline gelecek. Ah ah özellikle arkadaşınızı hayaleti atağa kaldırtacak etkinlik yapıp trollemek fena sarıyor :D. En büyük tavsiyem oyunda tarot kartı bulursanız oturun 4 kişi sıra sıra kart çekin ve hanginizin öleceğini o an şansına bağlı olsun.  Erken erişimde olmasına rağmen böylesine bir içeriğe sahip olması ve gelen her güncellemeyle daha da ileri gitmesi geliştiricilerin emeğinin ne kadar fazla olduğunu gösteriyor. Negatif gördüğüm bir olayı var mı derseniz sadece tek bir şeyi var o da belirli ekipmanlara ulaşmanız için seviye atlama zorunluluğu olması. Eğer yanınızda oyunu önceden oynamış birisi varsa hadi bu olaydan yine kurtuluyorsunuz ama 4 kişi ilk defa oynuyorsanız başta acı çekeceğinizden emin olun. Yoksa geri kalan her şeyi 10/10 durumda olduğunu bilmenizi isterim.  Gelecekte animasyonlar ve bir takım güncellemelerin de geleceğini o yüzden erken erişim bitmeden almanız ve olası fiyat artışından kaçınmanız en doğru karar olacaktır. Fiyatı oldukça uygun olmasıyla beraber her ne kadar buna benzer oyunlar çıkarılıp yapılsa da Phasmophobia'ya rakip olacak henüz bir yapım bulunmamaktadır.

Oyun beni ilk saatlerinde gerçekten çok eğlendirse de hayatın bazı gerçekleri var ki arkadaşlar bu da oyunun gerektiği kadar çeşitlilik bulundurmaması. Oyun korsanlık hissiyatını güzel veriyor ve eğer birkaç arkadaşınız da varsa oyunun tekrar etmesi size ilk seferde etki etmeyecektir ama benim oynadığım kadarıyla görevler sürekli şu adaya git hazine varmış bul onu sat, gemiyle giderken rastgele bir loot bulursan atla denize al ve sat. Oyun bulmak ve satmak üzerine kurulu ki bu konuda bir sıkıntım yok ama sürekli bir adaya gidiyoruz ve sadece birkaç çeşit iskelet var buralarda bir süreden sonra sıkıyor çünkü olay artık grind olmaya başlıyor ve grind yapmak için bir sebep de yok. Normal insanların da bir şehri olabilir ve bizler buraları da yağmalayabilseydik gayet güzel olurdu. Hatta buraların kaptanları ile aramızda bir ilişki olsa ve ona göre dost ya da düşman olsak tadından yenmezdi. Oyunun en güzel yanı temponun aynı kalmaması. Siz tam hazinenizi kazanmış. Güzel manzarayı karşı elinizde saz ve bir bardak rom ile ilerlerken amanın o da ne? Koskocaman bir köpekbalığı ya da suyun altından birden çıkıveren hayalet gemi. Bunlar tempoyu değiştirmek için gerçekten çok güzel araçlar olsa da bir süre sonra alışılıyor ve artık heyecanını kaybettiriyor. Bu arada oyunda bazı değişik görevler var hani bütün oyun hazine bul sattan ibaret değil ama büyük ölçüde hazine bul ve sat. Diğer görevler dediğim de zaten birisi iskelet öldürmek diğeri de taşımacılık. Oyun biraz rogue-like gibi ama rogue-like oyunlardaki kadar bir emek istemiyor çünkü karşılığında sunacak pek bir şeyi yok. Geminizi zaten geliştiremiyorsunuz. 3 adet gemi var ve bunlar mürettebatınıza göre seçebiliyorsunuz. Yani küçük,orta ve büyük olarak ayrılıyor gemiler. Gemilerinize kozmetik alabiliyorsunuz ki bunlar gerçekten yüksek fiyatlar istiyorlar neyse ki oyun birazcık bonkör sayılır. Oyunda bana göre - olan diğer iki şey ise birincisi karakteri geliştirememiz ikincisi ise oyun hani zaten az çeşitlilik barındırdığı için bence vuruş animasyonlarını değiştirebilsek çok hoş olurmuş. Zaten aşırı kötü ve monotonlar değiştirilebilir olaymış biraz daha katlanılabilir olurmuş. Oyunun en zevkli kısmı kesinlikle müzik aletleri bir savaştan çıkmışken veya günbatımına doğru farklı müzik aletlerinin birbiri ile uyum içinde çalması gerçekten çok güzel. Oyunda henüz kraken ile savaşnadık bu yüzden o konu hakkında bilgi veremiyorum ama muhtemelen o da diğer şeyler gibi bir süre sonra bayacak. Oyunda birkaç değişik yerler daha var örneğin birisi hayalet gemiler ile dolu ve tepemizde de bir kuru kafa konuşup duruyor o sırada da 10 gemi ile savaş halinde oluyoruz ve bazen bir bakmışsınız yanınızda başka bir korsan gemisi daha var. Tanımadığınız biriyle ölmemek için sırt sırta mücadele vermek güzel ama sonuçta bu oyunda herkes korsan onun için kimseye tamamen güvenmeyin:) Çünkü sonradan adamlar bizi batırmaya çalışmıştı uzun bir kovalamdan sonra köpekbalığı sağ olsun onların gemilerini yemiş biz de kaçmıştık. Oyunun güzelliği size tam huzur verirken bir anda her şeyi kaosa sürüklemisinden geçiyor. Dediğim gibi indirimli hali bile şuan yüksek bana kalırsa ama son zamanlarda beni gerçekten en çok eğlendiren oyun oldu. Yine de bu demek değil ki bu oyunu alın oynayın çünkü bana 14 saat oynamak yetti. Hani artık oyunu açmam için beni meraklandıran bir şey yok. Ayrıca gemiler ile savaşmak eğlenceli ama siz öldüğünün zaman sizi geri geminizde doğuruyor ki geminizde düşman işgalinde olduğu için sürekli ölüyorsunuz. Bir yandan gemi yanıyor bir yandan gemiyi su basıyor. Aşırı sinir bozucu. Arada bir manzara seyretmek için girdiğim ve balık tuttuğum bir oyuna dönüştü kendisi bu arada şaşıracaksınız ama balık tutma da aynı şekilde sıkıyor bir süre sonra. Elbette sonsuza dek oynanabilir bir oyun istemiyorum ama 14 saatte aşırı kısa her şeyi keşfetmek için. Bu kadar şey söyledim yok kardeşim ben hala alacağım diyorsanız. Korsanlık temasına aşıksanız tek oynanabilir. Biz 3 kişi oynuyoruz ama bazı durumlarda gemiye yetişmek gerçekten sıkıntı olabiliyor. Bu yüzden 4 kişilik bir grubunuz varsa büyük avantajınız olur benden söylemesi. Yine de oyundaki en küçük gemi tek kişi kontrol edebilsin diye özellikle yapılmış bir gemi. Bu yüzden tek başınıza da oyun size tamamen zindan olmaz.

Props to TwoWizards, even Realm Grinder's dev faded off with updates a couple years ago.  An idle game with a deeper magic system than most RPGs, 23 different classes each with their own playstyles, challenge runs for those who get bored of grinding, and great pacing so that you never feel like you're falling behind, Idle Wizard is definitely one of the greats of the Idle genre. A solid entry for both fans of the genre and people looking to get into it.

Vamos lá, é um jogo quase que terapeutico. Você irá passar horas num ambiente bastante imersivo com vários tipos de animais e diferentes coisas para se fazer. O jogo é muito real, e tem muito conteúdo, bastante para você ter que estudar os horários e tipos de comportamento de cada animal a ser caçado. Alguns possuem bom olfato, outros escutam muito bem, o que te obrigará a ler muito sobre como caçar cada animal, e não é fácil. Outro ponto desse jogo é que é bem desafiador, alguns animais que dão os maiores troféus são muito difíceis mesmo de se caçar.  Tentando não me estender demais, o jogo é ótimo na minha opinião, tem alguns bugs chatos as vezes, mas nada que eu me importe ou me atrapalhe, muito pelo contrário, quando entro nesse jogo me sinto mais relaxado devido ao ambiente e a trilha sonora que é um ponto a ser frisado, o áudio desse jogo é fenomenal.  Se for falar de pontos negativos, na minha opinião, o modo multiplayer carece de upgrades. Não dá pra jogar com ping baixo, é sempre uma experiência negativa em relação a isso. E tem o fato se você gostar do jogo mesmo, com certeza terá que gastar a mais para comprar as DLC's, recomendo comprar no mínimo a barraca e o cachorro, te quebrará um galhão.  Enfim, theHunter COW é um grande jogo que vale muito a pena, na minha experiência. Se procura um jogo relaxante e desafiador, daqueles que você não vê o tempo passar, vai que o tiro é certo.

My god, I was not expecting this to be as good as it was. Calling this a half life 2 mod almost feels unfair because there is so much work put into it that it really could be sold as it's own game. If this was a black mesa situation then I wouldn't have minded at all and payed any asking price but some how this is still free. Entropy: Zero 2 feels like the logical continuation of half life 2 and I am not joking when I say that. You play this time as a combine known as 36 who's both a villein and a anti hero sorta character. Unlike something like hunt down the freeman however you actually play an active role in the half life story that you can tell the dev's put a lot of thought into, just in case valve finally make a third half life game.  The game play is strong in this title with weapons feeling massively impactfull and there being a lot of variety between enemy's, puzzles and game play types. The game also looks fantastic for a source mod with a lot of custom assets and effects that really give you the feeling of playing something new. The music manages to capture that half life feeling perfectly and the voice acting is really good for a free mod. I could say more but honestly you should stop reading now and start playing. If you loved half life 2 and are still sore about there being no third game then this will be a solid title to give many fans itching for a new game something to fall in love with. To the dev's who made this, Thank you from the entire half life community. You can never be praised enough for this fantastic game.

Ремастер этой игры - это настоящий подарок для таких фанов Спанч Боба как я. Можно считать, что оригинал этой игры, был почти самой первой моей игрой, которую я до сих пор люблю всем своим сердцем, а её ремастер от Purple Lamp Studios даёт надежду на адекватное возрождение старых консольных Бобов. (в связи с аннонсом новой СВЕЖЕЙ игры от них же)  [b]Вот, краткое перечисление вмего того что я заметил при прохождении этого ремастера.[/b]  Все минусы и плюсы будут перечислены ниже.  [b]Сперва хотел бы поговорить про минусы ремастера:[/b] Если говорить честно, то в основном это всего-лишь косметический ремастер с небольшими изминениями и исправлениями недочётов оригинала. Из нового игрового контента здесь всего-лишь ни к селу ни к городу добавленный скучный ко-оп мультиплеер. Расстроило отсутствие Русской озвучки и так-же карявость и неправильность машинного перевода текста в диалогах и названиях. В отличии от оригинала, в котором Русского перевода небыло ни в каком виде, это хотя бы что-то. Но с таким паскудным переводом, всёравно советую играть только на оригинале - Английском. Багов, к моему счастью, я не словил за все время прохождения игры, кроме одного связанного с достижениями. Собрав все носки и лопатки, я получил только достижение за 100% игры и за все лопатки, носки забаговались и навсегда застряли на последнем несобранном носке.  [b]А теперь поговорим про плюсы ремастера:[/b]  Как я писал выше, этот ремастер в основном косметический, но геймплей и отмосфера стали только лучше. Уровни, персонажи и их способности, головоломки - хоть и остались те же самые, но хочу заметить то, что ремастер стал более динамичным и быстрым в отличии от оригинала, начиная от ускоренных боевых секций с роботами, которые стали чаще появлятся и аттаковать, так же и вы как игрок, стали ещё более подвижным и быстрым.  Также к плюсам, можно добавить исправление недочётов оригинала. Карты игрового хаба и некоторых уровней притерпели более заметного урезания площади невидимыми стенами, которые хоть и урезали игровую площадь собой, но при этом стали более логичными в отличии от оригинала где с их отсутствием ты мог не зная куда идти, выйти за карту, а потом удивлятся, почему рука капитана тебя оттягивает назад.  [b]Итог:[/b] Этот ремастер будет хорошим началом для тех кто не пробовал оригинал, которий уже заметно состарился на фоне красочного ремастера. Интересное изучение обхятных уровней и быстрей динамичный геймплей с шикарной стилизированной графикой и анимациями. [b]Однозначно рекомендую к ознакомлению и перепрохождению![/b]

The only reason I started playing this game was because I saw the messed up scene at the beginning and I really wanted to know what happened next.  I'm a sucker for dark games with a cutesy look but this game didn't suck me in 100%. The game offers little direction but it's not too difficult to figure out what you need to do to progress whether it's for a main quest or a side quest.  The only way to save is inside the house at your journal, the shrines that 'auto-save' outside do not save your game but merely remember which area to teleport you to if you die. I was lucky enough to find this out beforehand or else I would have lost a lot of data. The game does not explain this clearly.  There was an abundance of usable items around the town and dying didn't really feel like a threat at all, more of an inconvenience. I did get scared and jump whenever I did die though so that was fun.  The monster designs were creepy and some I could outrun and some I could not so I always had to be careful not to get carried away by running all over town. The boss fights were not difficult but could get tedious.  The ending had me a little confused so I had to look it up and a few forums on here explained it pretty well.  So in summary: The game offers little gameplay direction and explanations for story events but is enjoyable nonetheless. I just really liked exploring the town and filling out the map mainly.  I would recommend this game despite its flaws and I'm planning on playing the other Yomawari games.

I am a Project Cars 1 & 2 fanatic but when I bought AMS2, I never went back and play those games again.  This game feel different.  The FFB is amazing, you finally feel like you're driving a real car instead of slipping and sliding all over the place like in Project Cars 2.  This game make Project Cars 2 look like a toy game (that's exactly how I feel when I attempt to go back and try it once to compare).  You don't have to mess with the settings to get it right either, it works out of the box.  Granted that you have to find the car that you like first but once I found my favorite car, I never look back.  The Formula 10 Gen 2 is what got me hooked to this game.  It just feels right, you feel you're in control.  I don't know anyone else, but I am driving this game with a motion rig and its got the best telemetry out of all the sim games I tried so far.  I am using SRS software and I feel every bump, road texture and curb on my wheel (dd1) and on my rig.  Other games don't give me the same feeling.  That's another thing about this game, not only it feels right as far as FFB, it gives me the best telemetry motion.  I feel like I am siting in a real car and when it moves, oh man, forget about any other games lol.  Not only that, but it's got the best engine sound/car sound effects of all the sim games I played.  It sounds authentic to me like a real car.  It destroys Project Cars 2 hands down, no question.  I am playing this only in VR and I will say this:  It's the best RACING SIMULATOR for VR, bar none.  It's got pretty much everything that you want, it uses the Slightly Mad Studio engine from Project Cars...which mean it is visually spectacular in VR granted I wish they find a way to get rid of the jaggied shadow in VR though lol. I heard it's a bug that plagued the Slightly Madness Studio engine.  But the developers are enthusiastic and are constantly updating and improving the game.   Is there anything bad about this game?  Not really, if anything they need more contents.  More tracks.  I need tracks with longer miles.  For example, I love the Long Beach track but it's too short.  Of course, they're going to come out with more better tracks....so it's just a matter of time.  Tracks like some of the US oval tracks such as Texas Motorspeed Way or the Historic Spa track.  So I am looking forward to them being released.  Is it worth the price?  Is it too expensive?  I will say this...if you like the game and feel what I said above ring true, then it's worth the price.  Whether you like it or not is a subjective thing, everyone is different in preference and taste.  But in my opinion, this game scored a triple AAA.

SPOILERS FROM HERE ON OUT [spoiler] I'm going to be honest. I didn't play much of the first game. I finished the first visit to the first planet and stopped because I was playing the PS4 version and respawning took simply too long for a game that's about trial and error. That being said, not having played the first game, that honed in on the catchup the game did. I felt like I knew exactly what happened because of how well the game made sure that for new and old players, the story of fallen order was reiterated. Now moving on to this game's story. There's so many themes that go even past just the usual jedi stuff, but what really drew me in WAS the usual jedi stuff. It was explored in such a way I had never seen before, with Cal having difficulty with the negative emotions that usually lead to the dark side. However, he was able to control it somewhat, and kept the emotions at bay when it was important, with the help of his loved ones... loved one. Lol. The brotherhood between Bode and Cal was beautiful. Seeing two people bond so well due to a shared tragedy and also a similar past; losing their family; was wonderful to see. Bode frequently referred to Cal as his Brother, and I agree wholeheartedly. That's where the twist comes in. When it is revealed that Bode was working for the... rogue empire? Some kind of empire faction that didn't really care about the higher ups and would take in a jedi if it meant he works for their personal gain, I felt so worried. I was like, well shit. My favorite character is gonna die because he's silly. But no! The game makes his motives clear, wanting to protect his daughter at all costs. Calling him a villain would not be accurate. I feel like he was not able to control the dark side of his emotions as well as Cal had, though, due to being out of touch with the force all those years, working strictly as a bounty hunter. It sucked that Cal ended up having to kill Bode. I understand, but I was really hoping he would come around and we could all be a happy family, but I guess the game wants to set up for a third game, as it is implied Cal is going to teach Kata the way of the force. [b][u]2021年3月19日------------[/u][/b] 如今已经是一个小氏族的族长了，也算是玩到游戏中后期阶段了。有一些事情要提前说给要玩的玩家和其他带新人的玩家们。  [h1]给要入坑和已经入坑的萌新的提示[/h1]  首先，[b][u]这个游戏绝对不要去任何非官方渠道购买任何东西[/u][/b]。你说商城很贵？你可以等待签到给的-75%折扣，那个真的不贵。而且所有需要花钱的强度类物品几乎都可以交易频道掉落，饰品的话看个人就好，也不是一定要氪金的。 另外，这里提前说一个机制，就是黑金的问题。[spoiler]“一颗老鼠屎坏了一锅粥”，[/spoiler]一个人充值黑金，和这个人交易过的人都要倒霉。比如一个人冲过黑金，你与他交易过收到了很多黑金，那么如果他被查出来，交易给你的黑金也会从你账户扣除，也就是你纯粹的损失。如果你因为这个扣除导致账户白金数变成负数，那你也被封号，直到你商城原价买正，或者找客服抵扣你的付费物品。但是这个黑金扣除时间很随机，有可能去年你交易的人有问题，今年才扣，你可能不找客服永远都不知道为什么被封号。[b][u]所以一定要注意留交易截图。防止自爆卡车，也请关闭陌生人送礼物的功能。[/u][/b] 还有，这个游戏最棒的地方在于电影式任务，也就是主线。前期装备可能都不强，但是想要尽快拿到后面的装备一定要：收集，提升。不是选择要做那个，是都要做，做完水满不要的可以卖掉。只有这样，才能尽快接触到后面更酷的新任务和新装备。也就是说，[b][u]对于新人来说，主线，开图，水段位几乎就是所有要做的事情了[/u][/b]。这中间[b][u]需要大量的时间和经历[/u][/b]，请做好心理准备。  [b][u]关于游戏体验。[/u][/b] 如果你某个任务过不去，你可以尝试去组队频道，发出你的任务类型、星球，很多人都很愿意带你过去。也可以试试直接开野队，虽然很可能匹配的也是萌新。 不过到后面一些地图你可能会遇到一些人跑的飞快，有的人可能杀怪效率极高，请不要责怪他们破坏了你的游戏体验，因为这个游戏追求的就是这个，作为一个刷子游戏，效率就是一切。如果方案这样，你可以选择重新组一次队，或者单人。个人建议是[b][u]第一次打某个任务，以及所有的主线剧情，都请自己完成，[/u][/b]游戏体验是最完整的。  [h1]对于带新人的玩家。[/h1] 首先，[b][u]请不要着急新人玩家的强度提升[/u][/b]。你可以告诉他在这个游戏里应该如何发展，还有游戏的流程，但是请不要成为对方的保姆。你以为快速让对方到游戏中后期可以尽快体验新内容，但是实际上对方丧失了大部分对游戏内容的理解和认知，并且完全失去了游戏的核心体验。这样带出来的萌新几乎无一例外都不会超过200小时就弃坑。他们会错误估计这个游戏所需要的时间和经历，并且无法体验装备一步一步升级带来的成就感。这无异于帮他卸载了这个游戏。 其次，[b][u]请不要指责新人玩家[/u][/b]，除非做了很过分的事情。新人玩家对这个游戏知之甚少，伤害数字的一点点提升可能就会很高兴，如果这时候你到他面前说“这算什么？这也太拉了”的话那就会直接打击到对方游戏的动力。另外也请不要说“啊？你好蠢啊居然做这个事”“啊？你怎么老做这个东西？没用啊！”，这个游戏对新手的引导有点少是众所周知的事情，所以你应该告诉他应该怎么做，而不是数落他不该怎么做。 另外，[b][u]如果玩家卡在某个任务是因为忘记了任务的某个条件，也请不要过分批评[/u][/b]。对于新人玩家来说，并不是所有人都能准确抓住任务关键点，不知道如何判定，不知道地图结构，不知道任务流程是很常见而且很正常的事情。你可以告诉他去查wiki，也可以告诉他如何过关，但是请不要指责他。 [hr][/hr] [b][u]原评论------------[/u][/b] 标准的肝游，也可以氪金，也有段位。但是和同样有这些元素的游戏比起来，这个游戏你氪金能获得的都能肝出来，你段位高低并不能过多限制你的输出和能力，不仅如此，游戏的玩法还是多元的，技能也是多元的，有无限种可能性。（而且还是难得我的这个渣电脑能跑起来比较流畅的游戏，神优化）

As a huge fan of literally every single other FromSoftware game, it breaks my heart to leave this negative review. The  original Dark Souls might just be my favorite game of all time. So, when I complain about the difficulty here, keep in mind that I absolutely loved all the other games. The issue isn't 'git gud scrub'.  This is the single most unfun game I have ever played. The story is dogshit (at least from the first 15 hours or so), and they completely go against all the other Souls games by, instead of taking advantage of very minimalistic storytelling, the game throws absolutely monstrous monologues at your face every 15 minutes.   I'm baffled how they managed to do it, but the level design is also hideous, and most graphics in the game look worse than the original 2011 Dark Souls. Hell, at times it even looks worse than the original Demon Souls from what, 2008?  The bosses feel rushed, there's way too many of them, and almost none of them offer anything short of a boring and dull experience. The game relies way too much on constantly ambushing you and throwing you into tight spaces where you can't dodge, and the healing aspect is totally broken because, after a few  hours, you'll always have a bajillion life gems on you, providing practically infinite healing.  Despite this, I constantly died to the ambushes because of how god damn slow the healing is. 9/10 deaths were  barely my fault, and I never felt like there was a challenge to overcome.   The game feels unfair, unbalanced, and unfun. I really wanted to like this game, I really did. It pisses me off that I will now never see a part of the story of Dark Souls, because I doubt I will ever complete this game.  If I could get a refund, I would.   I cannot, under any circumstances, recommend this game.

The game completely goes off track with the Dead Space formula. Where the original Dead Space is isolated and focused more on survival and horror, Dead Space 3 is a lot more fast paced at times and you have a team with you, plus the option for co-op. EA have definitely messed the franchise up a little with what Dead Space Should be, and made a cash grab with the DLCs. That being said, I did enjoy the story and the optional side missions. The weapon crafting is frustrating as you can't spend much on parts due to spending resourches on med packs and ammunition. The game expands on the Dead Space universe and lore very well, but the DLC story ruins the main story line for me personally. Personally I believe the final entry in the Dead Space story could have been done better if you count the DLC the canon ending. Personally I prefer the main game ending. Overall, Dead Space 3 isn't a bad game, its just more of a disappointment when you compare it to its two older brothers that came before it. I recommend solely for the story & conclusion of Dead Space.

首先，优点： 1、继承了A社的优良传统，配乐、CG和UI做得省心悦目。 2、本作在进入现代时代之后可以将[b] 无神论 [/b]作为主要宗教，这对于文明来说是前进的一大步（^^)。 [b] 3、大航海时代的CG竟然是郑和下西洋，感觉真的前所未有的震撼。[/b] （凭着这段CG我觉得这个游戏就值我的一个推荐） 其次，缺点： 1、战略资源的机制确实有待提升，现有的机制下前期抢不到地后面就很难玩。 2、太像前作无尽帝国了。 3、对于文明的继承我真的有点不太满意，虽然这个游戏的名字是“人类”而非“文明”，但是一个文明能从周朝跳到南美土著再跳到欧洲工业文明再跳到非洲祖鲁，这就很不合理。可能像中国这样再每个人类的时代都有自己出类拔萃的代表的国家真的太少了，而游戏也不太可能给中国分配这么多比重。所以外国玩家也许能接受这种反复横跳，但是我觉得不如让文明按照比较真实的轨迹发展。 4、另外，你们把UI和CG画得这么好，[b] 然后整一个这么恶心的形象作为玩家的虚拟人物 [/b]，简直就是在破坏游戏体验。[b]尤其是中国的代表人物 [/b]（似乎是穆桂英？还是花木兰？），活脱脱一个典型的亚裔香蕉人，充斥着各种stereotype，亚洲口音的英语，动辄表情动作夸张，语气阴阳怪气大惊小怪，穿着的配色也完全不符合中式审美（经典红配绿，某种程度上可能也算是中式审美）。在你们眼中现代中国人就应该这样？ 其他的关于现代中国的特殊建筑我觉得倒是没什么，不能指望一个外国制作组深入了解中国的人民代表大会制度，以及其在国家治理中的作用和地位。 总体来说是部中规中矩的游戏，要是能一直忽略这个虚拟形象的话。

Howdy, fellow hunters! Sherry Darnel here, ready to share my thoughts on the exhilarating game, Hunt Showdown. Let me tell you, this game takes me back with its nostalgic gunplay. As a seasoned gamer who appreciates the classics, the gunplay in Hunt Showdown brings a wave of nostalgia. The variety of firearms, from revolvers to shotguns, reminds me of the days when I'd shoot cans off the fence posts back on the family farm. The attention to detail and the authentic feel of the weapons truly immerse me in the world of Hunt Showdown.  I can put much credit to RachtaZ, a remarkable Twitch streamer whose gamesense and movement in Hunt Showdown are truly commendable. His strategic approach and fearless tactics in the face of danger are awe-inspiring. Watching him navigate the treacherous swamps with precision and agility is like witnessing a masterclass in Hunt Showdown tactics. I've learned so much from observing his gameplay and have incorporated some of his strategies into my own gameplay.  Speaking of gameplay, Hunt Showdown offers an intense and immersive experience like no other. The combination of PvP and PvE elements creates a thrilling dynamic where danger lurks around every corner. The tension builds as you traverse the hauntingly beautiful map, battling both monstrous creatures and other hunters vying for the bounty. It's a game that keeps me on the edge of my seat, my heart racing with anticipation.  The atmosphere in Hunt Showdown is simply outstanding. The dark and eerie swamplands, the haunting sounds of wildlife, and the subtle creaks and groans of abandoned buildings set the stage for an intense and immersive hunt. The attention to detail in the visuals and audio design truly adds to the game's atmospheric charm.  Now, it's worth mentioning that Hunt Showdown can be quite challenging, especially for those new to the genre. The steep learning curve and the high stakes nature of the hunts require patience, skill, and precise decision-making. But fear not, as you gain experience and learn the ins and outs of the game, the triumph of a successful hunt becomes incredibly rewarding.  In conclusion, Hunt Showdown offers a nostalgic gunplay experience that captures the essence of classic firearms. The impressive gamesense and movement displayed by RachtaZ are a testament to the mastery that can be achieved in the game. With its intense atmosphere, immersive gameplay, and challenging hunts, Hunt Showdown is a must-play for hunters seeking a thrilling and authentic experience. So, grab your trusty firearm, follow in RachtaZ's footsteps, and let the hunt begin. Game on, y'all!

看到宣传图就被画风和角色设计吸引了，非常棒的美术风格！看得出来亲妈对oc们非常用心，有在努力表现出角色们的可爱之处，可以感觉到oc们的设计都挺有意思的，都有比较独特的点，可惜是游戏内容太少感觉没有很好的展现。rpg游戏不就是要四处调查嘛，可以明显感觉到操作茜缇的时候心理活动比其他角色要多哈哈哈。 这个小游戏作为宣传oc来说，我觉得已经非常棒了。人物设计本来就很优秀，加上细腻的文案、作者一个半月就爆肝出30+精致cg、氛围渲染到位的bgm、毫不拖沓的流畅剧情，从点开游戏起就很佩服你们搞oc的。。。  但是作为玩家来说，游戏体验并算不上很好……这个游戏给我感觉比起解谜rpg更像视觉小说，甚至是还要自己操作角色移动的视觉小说。基本没有解谜要素可言，所有调查基本都可以归为“找钥匙——开锁”的模式，也不能说是缺点吧，剧情党可能不讨厌，但是毕竟作为游戏玩家来说还是更希望“游戏”能有互动性、可玩性一点。 此外，许多”找钥匙“的过程都给我感觉很没逻辑。[spoiler] 为什么为什么u盘会卡在饮水机的出口啊，谁会把钥匙塞在杠铃里啊，为什么幽灵小妹妹们身上都刚好有我开下一道门的钥匙啊！如果作者想要加入解谜要素的话，设计关卡的时候请不要为了解谜而解谜！[spoiler] 许多设计都让我感觉：行吧我估计作者也是仅仅是因为想写这样的东西所以才写这样的东西的……玩的时候好想吐槽啊，但是番外房间看到作者自己也说了基本没有解谜要素，好吧！原谅了。 剧情没什么好说的，挺常规的，我觉得能完整地讲完一个故事就已经很好了。没怎么看宣传玩之前以为是日常冒险，没想到有恐怖元素，好像有点小突兀但是无所谓了，作者开心就好。  看评测说游戏有bug之类的需要退出重进，我是没有遇到这样的情况的，游戏本身没bug，挺流畅的。  对续作的期待：希望能有亲手暴打凶手的剧情

As críticas e avaliações usadas nessa análise foram escritas com base nas MINHAS gameplays e informações nas quais obtive acesso. Aqui vem um TCC, então prepara a pipoca ou a coquinha gelada e senta que lá vem história!      7 Days to Die (ou 7 dias de mortes incontáveis) é um jogo de sobrevivência no estilo tower defense, terror psicológico (??) e exploração. O mundo de 7 Days se passa originalmente em Navezgane (mas o mapa pode ser customizado ou gerado aleatoriamente), que até onde eu sei, foi vítima de uma bomba nuclear e resumindo toda a população virou zumbi, como? Não faço a mínima ideia.    O jogo funciona com um sistema de waves, denominado dentro do jogo como Lua de Sangue (Blood Moon), onde vem uma caralhada de zumbis das 22:00 até as 4:00 querendo seu corpo nú (expediente maior que putero). E sim. Na primeira Lua de Sangue tu sai numa trocação franca com uns 15 zumbi (por ondakk).  Progressão   O progresso dentro do jogo se baseia em níveis de XP, diagramas e fase de jogo. Literalmente qualquer coisa que você fizer dentro do jogo, você vai ganhar XP, menos andar e comer, dá pra farmar XP cortando mato (Exército Brasileiro deseja saber sua localização.). Com o ganho de XP, logo você ganha níveis de XP, logo vem pontos de habilidade e daí é só escolher um nível skill dentro de várias listas com dezenas de skills, cada uma delas tem efeitos únicos e que podem (e vão) definir seu progresso no jogo, mais para frente na análise eu dou algumas dicas sobre elas.    Os diagramas podem ser nomeados como jeito fácil de obter crafts sem depender de níveis de XP (porém as habilidades permitem na maioria das vezes craftar mais rápido e usar menos recursos), mas como todo jogo de loot, é totalmente aleatório o spawn e pode vir diagramas totalmente fodase.    A fase de jogo mostra uma média de progresso e nível de equipamentos que se está utilizando, logo quanto maior a fase de jogo, vem melhores loots, porém os inimigos ficam mais fortes.  Construção   O sistema de construção do 7 Days se assemelha bastante com Minecraft, usando uma mecânica de “blocos”, mas não totalmente quadrada. Literalmente o mapa inteiro é quebrável, mas não é tão simples assim, é necessário ferramentas específicas para quebrar mais eficientemente cada tipo de material (ou você larga o fodase e fica batendo 10 min numa parede de concreto usando o machado de pedra).    O método mais comum de construção é usando o Frame de Madeira, segurando o botão direito usando o machadinho de pedra, aquela simples armação vira um bloco de madeira (que é nada com porra nenhuma), segurando mais uma vez, se transforma e um bloco de madeira reforçada (usando apenas madeira), daqui pra frente é necessário materiais mais avançados para progressão, quanto mais se melhora um bloco, mais pontos de vida e resistência ele ganha. Exemplo: a madeira reforçada tem 250 pontos de vida iniciais, com 3 camadas: armação -> bloco de madeira -> bloco de madeira reforçada. Já um bloco melhorado usando Pedra Portuguesa, tem uma resistência de 1500 pontos de vida iniciais, com melhor defesa principalmente contra hits sem ferramentas mas tendo apenas 1 camada: pedra portuguesa. Conforme o frame usado para construção, pode-se ter mais vida base, mas também é mais caro de construir.    O jogo funciona com blocos, mas infelizmente (ou felizmente), a física se aplica nele, então quando for construir qualquer coisa suspensa, não se esqueça de usar vigas de apoio, ou será um belo show de detritos.    Água (rios e lagos) não foram 100% desenvolvidos, então nem cogite construir uma base aquática. Sério. Confia. Experiência própria. (ah, e os zumbis não morrem afogados para começo de conversa).    Mas a construção não fica presa em simples blocos, se você segurar “R” com o Frame selecionado na barra de ferramentas, é possível trocar para vários formatos de blocos, junto do menu radial também pode selecionar a rotação simples ou avançada e deixar a criatividade ir longe, só não esqueça de ter bastante madeira.  Armas e Ferramentas   Dentro do jogo podemos encontrar muitas armas e ferramentas com diferentes objetivos. No ramo das Armas temos o famoso melee (faca, machados, porrete e outras coisas que machucam) e armas de tiro mesmo (arco, AK-47, .12, .44, Rifle de caça e por aí vai). Ambas melee e tiro podem ser customizadas com modificações e pinturas, as modificações melhoram as características das armas, como maior dano, durabilidade, precisão, capacidade de munição etc. A capacidade de modificações se dá pelo nível da arma (que vai do 1 ao 6), no caso as armas e ferramentas de nível 1, suportam uma única modificação, enquanto armas de nível 6 suportam até quatro. Como foi dito antes, o loot do jogo é com base em RNG, mas o nível de progressão ainda se aplica. Então de começo você pode achar uma pistola nível 2, mas vai demorar um pouco até achar uma .44, quando estiver com as “armas iniciais” lá pelo nível 5 ou 6, começaram a vir armas melhores, mas de nível baixo, porém com status base melhores. (meio confuso eu sei)   Na parte das ferramentas o sistema de progressão é igual ao das armas. Mas temos um ponto importante, as ferramentas melhores (ferro e aço) consomem muito mais estamina por golpe, logo tentar abrir uma trincheira com uma pá de aço quando se está no nível 20 é loucura, você vai dar 3 hits e vai ter de esperar a estamina restaurar. Por isso, até você ter uma estamina lá pelos 170/180, ou senão tiver um estoque grande de café e energético, use as ferramentas de pedra com modificações.   Zumbis   Os zumbis no 7D2D podem ser de certa forma uns bixo bobão, mas muito pelo contrário, a IA deles é bem filha da p*ta. O objetivo dela é simples, traçar o caminho mais rápido até o player, logo se você estiver dentro da sua base, todos, eu digo TODOS os zumbis irão atacar o ponto mais fraco da construção, porque é a parte que menos tem defesa e o caminho mais rápido até você, então lembre de construir sua base de maneira uniforme, para não haver focos, ou você simplesmente pode usar a IA contra ela mesma.    Em questão de tipos de zumbis eles se assemelham bastante aos do L4D2, tem uma espécie de Hunter, uns zumbis gordão tipo um Boomer, os zumbis normais, tem a “Samara” que eu e meus amigos apelidamos, que depois da 19.5 teve um buff massa, ela é tipo um chamariz pra outros zumbis. Tem também uma espécie de zumbi motoqueiro, que seria um “normal” mas com mecânica de armadura, ou seja, senão tiver habilidade ou munição perfurante, o dano nele é nerfado, e tem o queridinho das prefeituras ou do teu amigo que vai construir, o motoqueiro com C4... sim... é um motoqueiro blindado, com uma C4 no peito, se tu atirar nela, ele mete um corridão igual um africano atrás de comida e xablau, abre uma cratera no chão (na melhor das hipóteses). E finalmente temos os comuns (e especiais) radioativos, onde a noite parece que tá enrolado em fita RGB, eles têm mais vida e contam com regeneração, então é um bom ponto focar em um até matar antes de ir para o próximo. For anyone trying to buy this, I suggest waiting for at the very least half a year. This game have all the core elements to be a great game, but at the moment there is only the core element, and everything else is in severe lack of polish. But personally, I will still recommend this game, because its basis is really that strong, there's just not enough content right now.  If you like 40k, or you like fast-paced game that reward high engagement, this game is for you, and the time you can spend playing it is well worth the price. The melee combat is visceral and meaty, the gunplay is wonderful with impactful sound and feedback. The enemy design are distinct and stylish both in the visual and audio aspect, with glorious gore and gibbing effects. The melee and long-range combat are tied together by the toughness and suppress system, and when you get in the flow, it feels wonderful.  But as I have said, this game lacks polish and content. There is currently only 5 maps in the game, mix and matched sometimes played in reverse to create 10 mission types, it is really not enough. The balance between different classes is still at a very weird state and is still constantly tweaked in patches. Premium cosmetic is a modern gaming nightmare with FOMO and premium currency shenanigans, and is just put on hold now. Server has some serious lag issue causing you to get pinned by specials when you really shouldn't be. And most of all, item RNG, which did not bother me that much, because I just play casually, but to a lot of the playerbase, the time sink for getting a good weapon is just too much.   All that, and the various technical issue, with weird server disconnect, crashes, poor optimization,make this game a sometimes wonderful but always very jank experience. It is worth the price, but as of right now, it may not worth the headache.   Update July 2nd: There is like two additional missions added which are based on remix of previous map with a lot of new zones added, and the premium store is starting to get updated again, I don't know I should be happy or disappointed, but I still suggest waiting for at least six months

Pros:  + Good pixel art & music + Interesting story (albeit convoluted at times) + Good humor + Great characters + The bond between Sombria & Luzia is really sweet  Cons:  - Sometimes the red exclamation points would appear even if I couldn’t actually interact with an NPC or object, which got a bit confusing - Although I found Luzia’s flippant attitude mostly funny, a few of her reactions seemed unfitting enough that it broke my immersion once or twice (such as when [spoiler]she and Sombria first meet the witch in the bathhouse[/spoiler]) - One ending (the one where [spoiler]everyone in the hospital dies[/spoiler]) appeared to have a minor bug where it froze on a black screen instead of rolling credits. I didn’t see that happen in a let’s play I watched, though, so maybe it was a one-time thing  I’m still not sure what was going on in some parts of the story, but I know I enjoyed the ride. Luzia and Sombria are great characters and seeing how they interact with each other and react to their circumstance was very entertaining. There are serious moments, but more often than not the tone is pretty laid-back for a horror game. If you’re squeamish about stuff like gore, don’t worry – it doesn’t really have that other than showing some blood, and it’s all pixels anyway. Although I think the amount of twists (there are a bunch) made the last parts of the story feel a bit muddled, all of the endings were still fun to get and it didn’t take away from how good the rest of the game was. Solid recommend from me.

Lily's Well is a great game, especially considering it's free. There are tons of little details scattered throughout the world that make progression all the more interesting, and I love how the plot unfolds. I thought the retro art style and music contributed a lot to the unsettling atmosphere (even if some of the higher notes started to bother my ears after a while). Don't underestimate the graphics - some scenes get pretty brutal. Collecting materials over and over again can get tedious, and I agree with the person who said the dead end screens linger a bit too long, but with how good everything else is, I can overlook those things. The game is only about 4-5 hours long (it took me a little over 5 hours to finish it and get all the achievements), so it makes for a nice short horror experience [spoiler]with a very satisfying true ending.[/spoiler] I'm eager to see what else this developer creates.

O açılış sahnesidir bizim hikayemizin başladığı yer. Şimdi gelelim Witcher 3 Wild Hunt'un incelemesine; Öncelikle bir inceleme tamamen kuratörün kişisel düşüncelerine dayalıdır, yani herkes aynı fikirlere katılmayabilir bu oyun hakkında. Witcher evreni bize üçüncü oyunla beraber ilk iki oyundaki başarısını nasıl katlayarak ilerletebildiğini gösteriyor. Witcher 3'ü almak için bir inceleme okumanıza gerek yok, bu oyun baştan aşağı bir şaheser. Şimdi otur koltuğun başına ve bu eşsiz deneyime hazırlan. Witcher'a hoşgeldin dostum.

Love this kind of puzzler. If you like Portal, you'll like this. Different tool-set but a similar logical structure, and those Eureka moments are highly addictive.  Difficulty ranges from easy to mind-splittingly hard.   A great aspect is that the puzzles are all scattered around different worlds/constructs, so if you're having trouble at any point you can just leave and try something else while your brain de-frags itself.    The game has a nice exploration side to it too, with plenty of secret areas for the completionists. The story is extraordinary. I really liked the focus on fear and how that factor plays into batman's progress as a character. The implementation of the joker in batman's head is not only a good call back to Arkham City but also plays a huge role in the story of Arkham Knight. I won't get too into the specifics of the story to avoid spoilers but just know that it is GREAT! Now I'm going to skip to the real nitty gritty; the batmobile, it's...meh. The tank battles are fun at first but soon after the initial start of the game they get real tedious and feel like more of a chore than something fun. The boss battles are also affected by the batmobile with the Arkham Knight and Deathstroke boss battles being purely tank focused (for the most part). I still stand by the batmobile as a good addition to the game though, the tank battles just needed to be used much less. Overall I'd give this game a 9/10. Has to be one of the best games I've played in recent times. I would like to praise around 90% of the game's aspects, but to keep it simple:  - Combat: This game has the best combat I've ever experienced in a third person game. At first, I expected the combat to be kinda wonky, but it turned out to be the opposite. Everything feels responsive, there's good feedback, and everything feels very well connected. Every move is well crafted enough to feel natural, and also, the enemies make you use all of the mechanics taught throughout the game, which makes combat at the end very dynamic  - Graphics: I don't know know how close this games gets to photorealism but holy shit, every time I walked to a new scene I had to take a photo because the environments look astonishingly good. The animations also help a ton, the motion tracking really paid off. Though I don't know if it's just me, but sometimes I felt that some of Senua's animations had a lower framerate (at this point I'm being very nitpicky)  - Voices: Don't want to spoil anything, but being the main selling point of the game, it does a great job at conveying this unusual way of narration in every way. The voices really feel like part of the player, and not just some mp3's put on top of each other.  - Mechanics: Every single mechanic is introduced and taught very well without the need of some text explaining what you have to do. Everything is conveyed in a very undersandable way, which makes for a very accesible experience.  Overall, great fucking game, honestly. Even if you're not a fan of the genre, like me, I'm sure you will enjoy it.

Antigraviator is a futuristic racing game that reminds me of Wipeout  The scenary are very beautiful, it's the biggest positive point of the game ! The circuits are quite varied and offer beautiful atmospheres and landscapes while integrating this well into the race itself.  https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2987806070  The game lacks customization on the vehicle point of view and could have a better management of rewards and ads on the campaign side... On some races of the campaign (2 or 3), the AI is just perfect and leaves no place for the slightest error, it can be quite frustrating. And they are some times no way to avoid some traps, like shield or something (this is sad haha). For me, those are really the only negatives point I find about this game !  [hr][/hr] On the other hand, the game offers you good hours of racing on several fairly distinguished racing modes, with a fairly advanced difficulty at some moments, which is quite nice I must say ! A trap system to be triggered in relation to the circuit is also available (avalanche, water leak, barrier, ...), which can be avoided most of the time when you know the spots of each one (just some cannot, like the locked target trap).  https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2987804458  In addition, a customization side of the appearance and stats of each vehicle is available, allowing you to adjust the acceleration, the handling and strength as you wish while keeping a certain stability in the statistics (some parts will give you a lot of speed but will greatly reduce your maneuverability)  [hr][/hr] Unfortunately this game was not well known by the community who did not try to see what the game offered after 1 or 2 races... Lots of false reviews: [list]     [*] [b]The handling is really clean[/b], but specific to the set up of the vehicle you are driving !     [*] [b]Traps are far from being a problem in the game[/b], they can be unpleasant at first but you have the indication of their spots and they are almost all dodgeable !     [*] The music is certainly not too varied but quite calm (in the menus) and dynamic in the race and it's more than enough ! [/list]  https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2987808624  For me the game is far from being AAA but remains a good futuristic racing game ! Certainly some games are better such as Pacer but Antigraviator keeps its share of originality oriented Arcade nostalgic and quite simplistic.  [b]I really enjoyed to play this game ![/b]

A fantastic co-op game if you don't expect it to be the same as Diablo or something like that.  It is really a challenging game with resource management and IMPORTANTLY require all players need to communicate. Therefore, I think that the problem of the game is the lack of tutorial and the matchmaking system.  The tutorial do not provide you enough information to really understand what you really need to do in the game to achieve the goal since it only show you the basic movement and how to interact with the environment of the game. Otherwise, if players are familiar with survival game such as Don't Starve, the tutorial literally do not help you at all. For the game with so many activities that are mandantory to engage in such as quest, building construction, limited-time events, explore hideouts, fighting bosses and creatures at night, gathering, etc.. they really need to make the tutorial LONGER and MORE INFORMATIVE.  For the matchmaking system, personally I think that it can't provide players a good experience with other players when playing the game. Literally it is 10 random people without clear purpose like end the saga mode, go to bilfrost as fast as possible, surviving to 15 days,... and due to that the players in matchmaking could never enjoy and explore the game until the last moment or going in the intended way of this game is to COOPERATE WITH OTHER PEOPLE AS A TRIBE. Simply, the matchmaking is bad because people don't understand what they REALLY need to do which come from the tutorial at the first place when they get in the game didn't give them ENOUGH INFORMATION TO KNOW WHAT TO DO!  Well, those are the 2 points that make me think that could heavily affect the experience of players at first try. But thanks to Discord, players can find other people to play with in there and communicate through voice chat and guide each other to fulfill the purpose of the game. And when  you can overcome the 2 big-ass obstacles that stop you from enjoying the game. Then, this is a wonderful roguelike survival/ tower defense game with Viking concept where you can have fun with friends/family. DEFINITELY WORTH A TRY AND FOR THE PRICE IF THEY ARE GOING TO UPDATE AND TACKLE THE PROBLEMS OF THE GAME

I'm going to be honest, this game is either a hit or miss; you're either going to have a very good time with it, get a little bit scared or jumpy because of it, and generally feel like it was a worthwhile experience in itself. However, after finishing the first playthrough, me and my friend came to the conclusion that you can make the most out of it if you're willing to put in effort entertaining yourselves and trying to make light of the game as much as possible. If you're a player that enjoys actually figuring out serious puzzles, or you're on the lookout for a new, scary game that will leave you antsy in your seat; this isn't for you. We had the most fun laughing at each others screams after cheap jumpscares, or trying to outsmart the monsters in the game by running around like headless chickens.  Another very evident thing to notice is that it is still in early access, which we found to be quite a setback when immersing ourselves in the game mechanics and the overall mood, which quickly got shattered when we found bugs, unfinished parts, or things that we believed would be really cool if they were expanded upon, rather than the underwhelming moments the game delivers. However, you can't really expect much else when you're putting yourself into buying a game that's still under development. Overall, buy at your own risk, don't expect too much from it, and take it in at a relaxed pace without thinking too hard about the negative parts :)  Overall rating: 7/10

A direct continuation of the fantasy yuri team adventures from the Sakura Knight. Same characters, same city, same value?  Story starts where the previous ended, and while a brief summary of the previous events opens this instalment, I recommended to finish the prequel first. You're still knight in training, still doing quests with your 3 fantasy heroines, and deciding who to end up with. Several obvious choices will lead you to loving, female arms of your liking. 3 non harem endings extend the short story but not by much. Whole adventure should not take too long to complete but this is reflected by the price of this VN, and I'd say justified by it. Writing is of the same overall quality as in the previous Knight title, so if you liked that you very likely to feel so again. Just some yuri hijinks sprinkled with bits of relations drama.  Character art done by the same artist, Inma, ensures good quality. Also ensures at best ecchi events. A few reused CGs as a cost cutting method is fine since majority are new. Same with character sprites and backgrounds, a lot are copied but there there are a few new ones squeezed in.   Similarly to art, music was also copied from the prequel. Tunes match the events for the most part and do so nicely, but more new tracks would be nice. Bit too much cost cutting to be honest.  No bugs encountered.  To summarise, a direct sequel to the Sakura Knight VN, with the same characters and setting plus mostly copied music and art. Story is light and silly, focused mainly on character interactions rather than action. Recommended mainly to those who enjoyed the previous part, otherwise, not really: 5.2/10

Another budget puzzle game from BambuseaeGames. If finding hidden objects is not your thing you might want to look elsewhere.  Unlike previous two titles from this dev, this time we're not shooting but simply clicking. You are tasked with finding objects placed around a stage. Number of objects to find varies per level but it is mostly less than 10 and all look the same. Don't expect much challenge finding them though. All can be completed in less than 30 min. without even trying. Honestly, this title is way less ambitious whenc ompared to previous games this dev released. Just 8 stages and gallery is all this game has to offer. It feels like a side project made just to build up finances to release better title. This product might be good for achievement hunters, maybe. Certainly seen worse for similar price.  Art is perhaps the best element of this puzzle game. Fairly decent backgrounds and characters. Simple animation was during reward scenes is a small plus. Not much effort was put here but for the price asked it is ok.  Music is relatively good. Every stage has a different track. Also, there is a very simple voice acting and moaning as well, which is not a standard thing in budget titles like this. Another small positive.  No bugs encountered.  Overall, a very simple hidden object game with only 8 unchallenging, stages, decent art and music. This is way less ambitious than other titles from this dev but if you enjoy simple puzzles or just farm achievements it might be good enough: 4.3/10

Spooky's Jumpscare Mansion ist ein schönes Horror Game! Obwohl das Konzept sehr simpel ist, gibt es viele kreative Ideen, die zum größten Teil auch sehr gut umgesetzt sind. Das Spiel baut eine sehr gute Atmosphäre auf, welche einem, gerade in den größeren Specialräumen, Angst einjagt. Auch wenn die Räume immer wieder die selben sind, ändert sich das Design der unterschiedlichen Level, was bereits für eine Veränderung der Stimmung sorgt. Die Anzahl und Verwendung der Jumpscares ist stimmig. Die Monster sind kreativ, jedoch ist nicht bei jedem Monster Abwechslung gewährleistet, viele bezwingt man mit der gleichen Taktik. Gute Ideen wurden zum Beispiel bei dem Wasserlevel und dem Specimen in Raum 610 eingebracht. Einen kleinen Minuspunkt gibt es von mir bei der Grafik, welche zwar an einigen Stellen absolut ausreichen ist, jedoch an wenigen Stellen sehr irritiert. Dieser Punkt wurde in der Neuveröffentlichung von Spooky's Jumpscare Mansion in 3D behoben. Overall ein sehr nettes Game mit einigen kreativen Ideen und damit empfehlenswert für jeden Horror Liebhaber!  ~ 8 / 10

I'm not really a big gacha game player, but when I tried CounterSide when it first launched for global, I was extremely captivated by the story. Its a really good read that may even make you tear up even if thats all you play it for. It gives the characters depth and makes them relatable. CounterSide also features fantastic artwork and music to really amp up the experience. Lore nerds rejoice.  Outside of the lore, I have found the gacha mechanics to be very forgiving and the cash shop isn't absurdly priced even if you just stick to the subscription option which will pay for the counter/battle pass on its own for you. While you probably won't have 100% completion of all the characters its extremely doable to get all of the ones that do matter. I routinely sit at 88%-90% completion without any help from spending and can clear most content if my units are specced for the content.  The combat is mostly geared around team building/strategy. You need to optimize which units you use, the order you use them, how you use their abilities, and know which content they excel at. There are plenty of guides online to help you with this. Gear is the primary aspect that will feel the most p2w probably. Getting the correct set bonuses and substats is basically just rerolling until you get the ones you want. You CAN pay for more to have infinite rerolls theoretically. However, as a f2p player the game gives out enough rewards to let you gear up enough to do PvP and higher end content without spending. Just don't expect to be #1 on the leaderboards. There is plenty of PvE content to keep you busy if PvP isn't your strong suit though.  There is quite a bit of guild content to do as well. The main one being a guild boss where you have to organize your guild to farm for buffs and take on the boss as far as you can go for rewards. You can earn currency to spend for items in the guild shop and to get temporary buffs for yourself or all the guildies. Overall if your guild has a strong social presence with each other, I can say its a very fun experience as a guild leader myself.  Lastly, I have to give a shoutout to the devs. The SEA and KR versions of the game were handled by other publishers, but Studio bside chose to self-publish the global version. The road was a little rocky with bugs in the beginning, but overall they have been very transparent with their goals and future plans for the game. They are currently planning to catch us up to KR/SEA versions so its a good time to jump in with a lot of content and rewards coming in the future. Overall, I find CounterSide one of the most enjoyable gachas I have played and I intend to be a long time player as long as the developers keep the communication and transparency they are doing now.  Edit: The big New Origin update came out and I am still playing. While there have been minor gripes I feel people are over-blowing it.   1. The prestige system. A cosmetic skin to thank whalers is not a problem. They help drive the game's profits so we don't have to. Theres smaller rewards in there too for smaller spenders. Complaining about p2w elements is reasonable, but its a fking cosmetic.  2. No exp gain from battles. Prior to the update leveling up characters was extremely easy. You don't need to level every character up, just the ones that are actually meta relevant. Making it a little more challenging is not inherently a bad thing and it removes the need to work out a lvl up squad. They upped credit & appraisal drop rates as of Feb 15 so the situation should be a little better.  3. The constellation system. Dupes can no longer be used for unit fusion and is fusion core only. Fusion core requirements and rewards have been adjusted to account for this. Dupes only serve for rearm data & to give your unit small stat buffs. Max constellation requires 6 dupes. No PvE content is made with it in mind and it only gives a small edge in PvP. Unless you are fighting grand master/challengers in PvP I would just work on it as you go.  tl;dr the game was made a little harder and a skin was given to whales and people lose their minds.

[h1]Das Game wär fast ganz gut geworden, aber.. [/h1]  Okay wo fange ich an. Tell Me Why ist ein Spiel der DontNods, den Entwicklern der Life Is Strange Spiele, wo ich Teil 1 wirklich liebe, trotz seiner Flaws. Ich hab Tell Me Why auf meine Wishlist gesetzt und geschenkt bekommen, weil ich echt interessiert war in vielleicht eine neue mitreißende Reise. Ich hab an einem freien Tag es komplett durchgespielt an einem Stück und ich muss sagen, meine Erwartungen waren nicht hoch, ich hatte eher Sorge, dass weil der eine Protagonist ein Transgender ist, es immer drauf hingewiesen wird für leichte Eigenpromo und die Charaktere und Story dadurch zu kurz kommen, aber tatsächlich bekam ich ab Kapitel 2 nicht mehr das Gefühl, dass das noch großartig wichtig war, sondern eher unter anderem ein Antrieb war, der die Story in seine Richtung getrieben hat, denn die Ausgangssituation des Spiels ist, dass die Zwillinge Tyler und Alyson sich nach 10 Jahren wieder sehen, aufgrunddessen das Tyler im Jugendgefängnis saß für den Mord seiner Mutter, die ihn laut seiner POV (Point of view) umbringen wollte, weil sie mit seiner Transition nicht umgehen konnte. Die Geschwister besuchen das alte Haus, wo alles stattfand, da das verkauft werden sollte und finden Beweise, dass die Mutter Tyler vielleicht ihn nicht umbringen wollte, weil sie mit Transgender nicht klarkam, sondern das es nur ein Missverständnis war und es andere Gründe gab, warum die Nacht so geschah, wie sie es tat und die Zwillinge sind auf der Suche nach der Wahrheit. Auf ihrer Suche können sie ihre übernatürlichen Kräfte benutzen, welche das Gimmick des Spiels ist, wie bei LiS1 das Zeitreisen oder LiS2 die Telekinese: Telepathie. Die Zwillinge können über Gedanken kommunizieren und ihre Erinnerungen in die Welt projizieren, die nur sie beide sehen. So kommt es auch zu Situationen, wo die Zwillinge unterschiedliche Erinnerungen haben, unterschiedliche POVs ihrer Erlebnisse, der gleichen Situation, was ich einen ziemlich genialen Twist fand, was leider gegen Ende des Spiels nicht oft genutzt wurde, generell wurden viele kleine Spielereien in Tell Me Why eingebaut, welche sich retrospektiv angesehen einfach nur wie stretching des Contents anfühlt, als wirklich was zum Game beizutragen und das kommt, würde ich sagen, auch von der Länge des Spiels, denn mit nur 3 Kapiteln ist es nicht länger als Before The Storm, das Life is Strange 1 Prequel, welches perfekt in seiner Länge war, weil es noch eben LiS1 hatte und das Prequel mehr ein bisschen Hintergrund zu einem der Charaktere gab, nur bei Tell Me Why ist es die Sache, dass sie nicht nur Hintergrund geben wollen, sondern eine ganze Welt aufbauen möchten innerhalb von 12 Stunden á 3 Kapiteln und man merkt an manchen Stellen, wie der Plot manchmal voran geschubst wird, damit es weitergeht. Es wird sich nicht immer die Zeit gelassen, die es braucht um eine ordentliche Climax zu schaffen, was sich daran wiederfindet, dass ich zwar Kapitel 1 und 2 gut fand, auch den Anfang von 3, aber das Ende einfach schrecklich ist, aufgrund von fehlendem Impact und verwirrend unpassenden Plottwists und Verhalten der Charaktere. Über die Story hinweg kriegt man Optionen Charakteren zu verzeihen, die in der Nacht involviert waren (oder auch nicht), man kriegt die Infos was vermutlich geschah, man spielt die Protagonisten im eigenem Sinne und entwickelt sie, wie man sie spielt und am Ende, wenn der große Reveal kommt fühlt sich die Reise nicht so an, als hätte irgendwas gezählt was man tat. Keine Entscheidung hatte wirklich Impact auf die Story oder irgendein Ereignis, da man im Prinzip nur im Spiel Dialogoptionen hat und ein paar größere Entscheidungen, die aber nur die Beziehung zwischen den Geschwistern stärkt oder schwächt, was glaube ich, nur Einfluss auf eine Sache ganz am Ende nach den Credits hat und halt für eine Steam Trophäe. Und egal wie du die Protagonisten spielst, am Ende steht man vor der einen Entscheidung, die man auch im ersten Kapitel hätte stellen können, gleich in der ersten Stunde. Was ich wähle war nicht mal eine schwere Entscheidung, weil es für mich absolut klar war, was passiert ist, für die Protagonisten wiederum nicht aus irgendwelchen Gründen, die Geschwister taten gefühlt so, als wären die letzten 2 Kapitel davor nie geschehen. Außerdem fühlte sich meine Option an als wär es das Bad Ending, weil (Spoiler) [spoiler] Die POV nicht von den Zwillingen kam, sondern vom Vater, der in der Nacht halt da war, aber erst in dem letzten Kapitel revealed wird und für mich absolut lächerlich war, weil es sich anfühlte als hätte man den nur verwendet, weil man mit dem nichts mehr gemacht hatte bis zu dem Punkt und man den noch irgendwie mitunterkriegen wollte. Ich hab übrigens gewählt, dass das nur ein Missverständnis war und die Mutter nicht ihr Kind töten wollte, weil es Transgender ist, sondern nur die Flinte in der Hand hatte, weil sie Suizid begehen wollte oder ihre Kinder beschützen wollte oder so, ich weiß es nicht. Das Ende erschien mir am logischten nach der Reise und ich denke nicht, dass ich eine Sache verpasst hatte, die das irgendwie in Frage gestellt hätte, besonders da ich meine, dass sogar der Transgender Mensch selbst auf den Schluss kam, dass die Mutter nichts gegen seine Transition hatte, aber dennoch ist er mega angepisst auf sie in der letzten Entscheidung out of nowhere. Was mich auch verwirrte war, dass die Schwester ihrem Onkel, dem Polizeichef, gestanden hatte, dass sie eigentlich die Mutter umgebracht hatte in der Nacht und nicht Tyler und dennoch der Vater gedroht hatte sie zu verraten, obwohl das längst raus ist und die Schwester dennoch panisch dadurch wurde. Zumindest kann ich das eher nachvollziehen, weil sie hätte dann vermutlich erst recht eine Strafe bekommen müssen oder so. [/spoiler] Auf jedem Fall fand ich das Ende nicht gut, auch wenn die Reise dahin vielversprechend fand. Gameplaytechnisch waren die Welten voll für Erkundungen und Sammelobjekte gabs auch. Die Idee war cool mit einem eigenen Märchenbuch, das relevant für Rätsel im Spiel war. Die Charaktere waren weitesgehend angenehm. Es war nicht ständig schwarz und weiß, nicht jeder hat den Transgender abgelehnt, weil sie damit nichts anfangen konnten. Eine hat über ihren Glauben hinweg gesehen und ihn akzeptiert, einer hat sich Mühe gegeben es zu verstehen. Generell fand ich Tyler gut in der Geschichte eingebunden mit seiner POV auf seine Kindheit im Kontrast zu Alysons POV. Alyson als zweiter Protagonist fand ich gegen Ende immer besser, weil sie mehr Charakter bekam, jedoch wie gesagt, am Ende verhielten sie sich untypisch und ich fand das nicht gut. Zu guter letzt noch das Voice acting, Ich hab tatsächlich mit deutscher Dub gespielt und deutschen Untertiteln und ich würde jedem abraten das zu tun, denn das Gesagte ist nicht gleich den Untertiteln. Spielt lieber mit englischem Voice acting und Untertiteln oder auf Deutsch ohne Untertitel at all. Die Stimmen selbst waren voll okay, kein Meisterwerk, dennoch nicht schrecklich.  Würde ich nun aber Tell Me Why empfehlen? Zum Sale ja, wenn man Fan von DontNod ist, dann klar, es ist halt ein nettes Spiel für 12 Stunden und nur weil das Ende schrecklich ist, ist es nicht der Weg dahin. Ich würde sogar fast sagen, dass es seine 30€ Wert sind, aber da ist mir das Ende und die Länge dann doch zu doof.

Overall, I love this game! Great builder that lets you go into nearly microscopic detail of constructing and managing a relatively realistic zoo. Campaign mode gets boring pretty fast, and in my opinion isn't worth playing past the tutorial sections. The game really shines as a sandbox, giving you enormous plots of land, an enormous selection of animals, and literally tons of customizable items and building materials. The Steam Workshop community is active and the integration of blueprints (similar to a Sims Gallery where you can grab other people's builds and drop them in) has only minor flaws.  All that being said, there are definitely some areas of the game that are frustrating. The controls are what bugged me the most. Panning the camera, placing items, and laying down paths are three of the most essential things you are required to do to actually play the game. Unfortunately, they're also three of the most frustrating. Overworld and building controls feel unintuitive, and the tutorials really only provide bare-minimum understandings of the game's mechanics (which get very complicated very quickly). I'm definitely not a fan of Let's Play style videos, but YouTube tutorials are basically required watching if you don't want to waste hours just trying to understand how the game works.  In short, Frontier did pretty good with this one. Fans transitioning in from Planet Coaster and JWE won't have too much trouble picking up the basics, especially with outside help. Fans of older park builders like Zoo Tycoon will also enjoy this game, but be warned that it is a whole world more complicated, and you're going to have to spend more time and effort getting a place where you CAN enjoy it. In the end, your zoo can be as simple or as complicated as you want it to be, much like your experience with the game. I count that as a win.

So far, so good.   Performance and Optimization: Excellent!  Ryzen 5 5600x, X570 mobo, RTX 3060Ti, 32gb 3600mhz RAM, and WD Black SN850 gen4 NVME Getting a solid 60fps (capped due to TV hz) at 4k Epic settings, DLSS-Off, No stutters or Texture popin, and Excellent sound.  Graphics: Good. Not mindblowing graphics, but nonetheless good.  Main character:  Nora (MC) is a stoic person on the outside, but deeply troubled by her past fighting for the cult she left due to leadership going too extreme. This is reflected in her inner dialogue with herself. It gives a rather good contrast on how she wants others to see her and how she sees herself. Voice acting has so far been solid and emotion is being shown, which adds a nice weight and helps carry the overall game narrative.  Other characters: So far some have been so-so to pretty good. Only a couple hours in so haven't heard all of it, but if this is the level of quality they are putting into even one time encounter 5 minute sidequest characters then it gives a good feeling of quality and thought was put into interactions within the game  Combat and movement: Very good. Controls are responsive and i had no issues with either controller or M & K. Enemies are very mobile, and so are you. So combat can get pretty hectic. HP and Shield having a fast recharge contribute to this by allowing you to stay in the fight. Leading of course to more fun. Think of the combat as Doom 2016 (This game) was to CoD: Modern warfare (Everspace 2).  Overall Score (As of 2.6 hours): 7/10 (Would be a 9 if you could walk around as Nora for character interactions, but perhaps in the sequel if this game does well enough.  This may go down or up after i finish the game, but if the game only gets better from here, it'll easily hit a 9 or 10.
